|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[The Empire's Back (V)]] (version 2 of 2). It is the current text. Each version is the Players Committee's own card image, quoted in full with its upload date; the image on each page is that version's image as published (unchanged). The PC card data (swccg-card-json) is cited as dating evidence only.
* '''Original''' ([[The Empire's Back (V)]]): the card image at official release (20 July 2024)<ref name="ht-335d47f">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/theempiresback.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Dark/large/theempiresback.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36 335d47f] “Set 23 new images”, 20 July 2024.</ref> prints: “USED: ▼ Empire’s New Order or Overseeing It Personally. LOST: Once per game, choose: Place an opponent’s just-played Interrupt out of play. OR If Xizor (or two Imperial leaders) in battle, re-circulate.”<ref name="cj-753083f">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/753083f swccg-card-json commit 753083f] “Set 23” (21 July 2024) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the errata card image (7 March 2026, for the PC's 2026 errata (“Tweak Set 2026”))<ref name="ht-23b4dc9">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/23b4dc91123cec2827f5084f60e2378f88594306/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/theempiresback.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Dark/large/theempiresback.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/23b4dc91123cec2827f5084f60e2378f88594306 23b4dc9] “DS Errata”, 7 March 2026, for the PC's 2026 errata (“Tweak Set 2026”).</ref> prints: “If two Imperials (or two Black Sun agents) in battle, re-circulate and shuffle your Reserve Deck. OR Once per game, if Emperor or Tarkin on table, Allegations Of Corruption stacks opponent’s just played Interrupt; this does not count toward that card’s once per game limit.”<ref name="cj-12dc019">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/12dc019 swccg-card-json commit 12dc019] “Tweak Set 2026 - Dark” (14 March 2026) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' The card became a Lost Interrupt (it was a Used or Lost Interrupt) and was rewritten. Removed: the USED ▼ of Empire’s New Order or Overseeing It Personally and “Place an opponent’s just-played Interrupt out of play”. The re-circulate option became “If two Imperials (or two Black Sun agents) in battle, re-circulate and shuffle your Reserve Deck.” (was “If Xizor (or two Imperial leaders) in battle”), and “OR Once per game, if Emperor or Tarkin on table, Allegations Of Corruption stacks opponent’s just played Interrupt; this does not count toward that card’s once per game limit.” was added. The card image prints the errata mark “E1” at bottom right.
